findings.key_quote: Our total revenues increased $32.2 billion or 4.7% and $32.9 billion or 5.1% for fiscal 2026 and 2025, respectively, when compared to the previous fiscal year.
findings.justification: This passage directly states that total revenues for fiscal 2026 increased by 4.7% compared to the previous fiscal year (fiscal 2025). Since 4.7% is greater than 4%, this entails the assertion that total revenues increased by more than 4%.

E7 shows total revenue for FY2026 was $706,413 million and E8 shows total revenue for FY2025 was $674,538 million. The growth rate is (706,413 - 674,538) / 674,538 = 4.73%, which is greater than 4%, entailing the assertion.
This derived metric shows the year-over-year revenue growth for fiscal 2026 was 0.0473 or 4.73%, which is greater than 4% (0.04), directly entailing the assertion.
